scope: Authenticated server pages for the applicant list, complete authorized filters/counts/facets, explicit full selection for quick review and voting. Existing canonical privacy projection remains authoritative. No database/schema/infrastructure/security changes.
knownLimit: Page responses and browser work are bounded to 100 rows; privacy-aware filtering/sorting still scans the authorized summary set on the server. This phase does not claim bounded SQL cost.

measurement.powerControl: Temporary local caffeinate, verify no Sleep within accepted collection. Exclude whole collection if suspended; retain all rows.

security: Live identity/session/account/membership/capabilities on every GET, same no-store/Cookie handling and Demo isolation; mutations and voting snapshots unchanged.
acceptance: Global filtered totals and facets; stable IDs break sort ties
Cursor cannot authorize or cross a selection/club/actor scope; every request reauthorizes
Full quick-review and voting selection is explicit and complete, never limited to current page
Rapid filters/navigation fence stale results; preserve drafts and keyboard focus
No unsupported claim of hosted or multi-client performance
publication: Local commit only; no push/merge/deployment authorized for this phase.

additionalInteractions.blocks: same BA/AB blocks as primary navigation
